name: ask-opencode
title_zh: 每轮工具调用都等你点头的 opencode 对话桥
tagline_zh: 用户说「让 opencode 看看这个」，你不再只能转述一段死板的单次输出——它把多轮对话拆成一问一答。
tagline_en: When the user says "have opencode look at this", you get a real multi-turn conversation — one turn per call, and.
desc_en: Drive a multi-turn conversation with the opencode coding agent through this skill's ask_opencode.py, one turn per tool call, with every tool call opencode wants to make coming back to you for approval. Reach for this whenever the user names opencode as the agent to consult - "ask opencode", "have opencode review this", "what does opencode think", "run it by opencode", "get opencode to look at this
why_zh: 把 agent 的自主权切成可审的一轮轮：每步工具调用都过你的手，既不丢上下文，也不放任它自己乱跑。
why_en: It slices the agent's autonomy into auditable turns: every tool call passes through you, so context survives without letting it.
limit_zh: 只驱动 opencode 这一个 agent，换别的 CLI 直接不认。
limit_en: Drives opencode only — other CLIs are ignored. Requires opencode installed and a working model configured, or turn one stalls. Conversation state is.
title_en: Multi-turn opencode chat where every tool call waits for.
